subject: While They Rest, You Restock the Pipeline
previewText: Labor Day week is a gift for agents who know what to do with it. Here's the playbook.

featuredArticle.title: How to Work Aged Leads: The Complete System for Maximum ROI
featuredArticle.spotlight: If you've been buying expensive fresh leads and wondering why your CPA keeps climbing, this is the piece to send yourself right now. It lays out the full system — scripts, follow-up cadences, and the actual economics — that turn a $2 aged lead into a better ROI than a $40 exclusive one. This is the framework I've used for two and a half decades, written down in one place.

industryInsight: The One-to-One Consent Rule Is Dead — For Now
